comparison.objective: Square a racked gantry by sliding both rail carriages onto their end stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual synchronized pushing, load sharing, and binding avoidance on constrained rails.
comparison.success_condition: Both carriages seated against 0.05 mm stop tolerances, beam stable, and grippers released; earlier versions omit slide-path enforcement, later versions require on-rail travel.
comparison.reason: No pouring, granular transport, aperture screening, selective retention, or spill-sensitive media recovery.
